title: 聊天機器人 — FAQ QnA + Microsoft Foundry AI (第二階段)
content: 實作網站聊天機器人：第一階段先用確定性 FAQ QnA（基於常見問題字典），第二階段整合 Microsoft Foundry AI 進行語意問答。屬於第二階段功能，需等所有 Phase 1 Epic 完成後才開始。
epic: 第二階段：學員與講師功能

evidence.residual: Phase 2 — depends on all Phase 1 Epics complete. No implementation work until then.

acceptance: Chatbot widget visible on all public pages — floating button opens chat panel
Phase 1: FAQ mode — keyword matching against a curated FAQ dictionary, returns pre-written answers in correct locale
Phase 2: Microsoft Foundry AI integration — natural language understanding, context-aware responses
Multi-locale: chatbot responds in the same locale as the page being viewed
Admin-configurable FAQ content via dictionary or CMS
Chat history stored (opt-in) for analytics and improvement
Responsive design — works on mobile as slide-up panel
